Hi Camila,

Thanks for taking this on. We're starting our procurement intake for the deal with Redwood and wanted to share the initial order form and a short SOW for scoping. Attached: Nebula_OrderForm_v0.1.docx and Nebula_SOW_20260301.pdf.

High level asks from our side:
- Can you map our order form fields to Redwood's order form template and indicate any template clauses that will need redlines?
- We need clarity on hosting/residency exhibits (we're evaluating multi-region residency but may need EU residency later). Can you flag residency clauses and exhibit ownership?

If helpful, we can schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow morning PT to walk the documents.

Thanks,

Nebula Systems, Inc.

Subject: Re: Order form + MSA onboarding info (Nebula Systems / Redwood)

Hi Elena — appreciate the docs and the clear asks. Quick response and next steps below.

Summary of what I'll do this week:
1) Run a field-to-field mapping between your order form and our standard Order Form template and call out: scope fields that don't map, commercial items requiring SOW Exhibit, and any non-standard liability/payment language that typically gets redlined.
2) Flag residency/hosting language: I'll highlight exhibit placeholders for EU/region-specific residency and note the standard options (hosted API vs. Dedicated vs. Private).
3) Confirm billing/tax: please confirm whether Nebula will be billed in USD or EUR and whether PO numbers are mandatory.

I've attached our RW_Template_OrderForm_202602.docx for mapping.
Proposed cadence: I can share an annotated mapping doc by EOD Wed (03/04). If that works, let's schedule a 30-min intake call tomorrow 10:00–10:30 PT (I'm in PT) to clarify signatory and billing contacts.

Notes for internal team (Kimberly / Jonas) — please weigh in on security/residency flags and whether we should pre-attach our standard Exhibit: Residency & Hosting (EU carve-out) or keep it as a follow-up based on their selection.

Thanks — Camila
Camila Reyes | Senior Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

Camila — thanks, that plan is great. Quick clarifications before the call:
- Billing: USD preferred, PO required (we'll supply PO# after countersignature).
- Signatory: our CFO (Tom Li) will be the signatory; I'll loop him into contract review after your mapping.
- Residency: initial deployment will be US-only, but we need an option for EU residency in the order form (may be activated in Q3).

We've also attached a brief SOW showing expected API throughput (for your capacity planning). Happy to join the call tomorrow 10:00 PT.

Elena

Subject: Internal: Nebula intake — residency & evidence checklist

Camila / Kimberly,

Thanks for the heads-up on Nebula. Quick internal note ahead of our call:
- Residency: we'll include a draft Exhibit: Residency & Hosting with options for US-only, EU-optional activation, and Private/VPC on-prem addendum. That lets procurement pick without full redlines up front.
- Security evidence: request SOC 2 Type II and a short data flow diagram before agreeing to Dedicated/Private options. If they only need Hosted API with EU residency toggle later, we can proceed with a lightweight evidence set initially.
- Commercial redlines to watch: payment terms (Net 45 vs. Net 30), termination for convenience language, and indemnity cap. I'll draft suggested positions for the mapping doc.

I'll be on the intake call and can jump in for the residency mapping.

-Jonas
